OUR STORES

UNIQUE FASHION WOMEN

 
 
 
 

Built on the foundation of craftsmanship, integrity, and an understanding of what Indian women truly seek in their wardrobes, Unique Fashion evolved from a close-knit family business into one of North India’s most beloved ethnic wear brands. 

“Unique Fashion” was named after the founder, Mr Sachin Kharbanda’s daughter, born during an auspicious year for the family. Meaning “distinguished” or “marked with purpose”, it is a reflection of the woman the brand designs for. Thoughtful. Graceful. Confident in who she is.

What started as a commitment to creating well-fitted, beautifully crafted garments slowly became a legacy trusted by generations. Mothers introduced their daughters to Unique Fashion. Occasions were dressed in Unique Fashion. Milestones were celebrated in Unique Fashion.

With a proud 25-year legacy, Unique Fashion stands as one of North India’s leading brands of ethnic wear for women, known for redefining modern Indian fashion. Rooted in tradition yet designed for today’s woman, Unique Fashion offers a versatile range of ethnic wear, fusion wear, and contemporary western styles—from effortless kurta sets for women to refined co-ord sets, suit sets, festive wear, wedding wear, and contemporary fusion styles. 

Today, Unique Fashion stands strong with an expansive retail footprint of nearly 100 stores across India, a growing marketplace, and an omnichannel presence, as well as the recent launch of the Unique Fashion App bringing premium Indian wear closer to women everywhere. Whether in-store or online, the experience remains the same: thoughtful designs blending heritage-inspired craftsmanship with modern silhouettes to create fashion that feels effortless, empowering, and distinctly yours.

The Unique Fashion Promise

Trusted by generations of women for timeless Indian ethnic wear.

Unique Fashion is recognised for its intricate embroidery and refined detailing, crafted to celebrate Indian artistry.

Available in sizes up to 4XL for a confident, comfortable fit.

Enjoy complimentary lifetime alterations on your Unique Fashion purchases.

Same Day Dispatch

90+ Stores Across India

Experience our collections up close, wherever you are.

Frequent Seasonal Launches

With regular seasonal launches and fresh collections throughout the year, Unique Fashion offers a diverse range of styles, from festive favourites to everyday essentials. 

Free Shipping

Enjoy free shipping on all orders within India.

Trusted Shipping Partners 

Your wardrobe deserves reliability. 
We collaborate with some of India’s most reputable and trusted shipping partners to ensure your orders arrive safely, efficiently, and on time. 

Made in India

Designed and crafted in India.
Celebrating the country’s heritage with modern sensibility.

Wear it Everywhere 

There is a Unique Fashion style for every moment on your calendar. From easy everyday wear for work and casual outings to detailed suit sets for festive gatherings, celebrations, and special occasions, there’s a style for everything. Whether it’s a relaxed brunch, a family function, a wedding event, or an evening out, Unique Fashion offers impeccably crafted pieces that move seamlessly with your lifestyle effortless, elegant, and always appropriate. 

The Road Ahead 

As a leading innovator in ethnic wear for women, Unique Fashion is embracing innovation to shape the future of Indian fashion. The brand is moving toward an AI-driven shopping experience across its website, app, and omnichannel platforms offering personalised style recommendations, smarter size guidance, and a seamless online shopping journey. With plans to begin international shipping, Unique Fashion aims to bring its premium kurta sets, festive wear, wedding wear, and contemporary Indian silhouettes to women worldwide.
At the same time, Unique Fashion is preparing to launch a dedicated loyalty programme to reward its valued customers, expand into new categories, and experiment with modern silhouettes and design directions. By investing in the latest machinery and advanced in-house manufacturing processes, the brand continues to strengthen quality, precision, and innovation ensuring that Unique Fashion remains a trusted Indian wear brand for generations to come.
